## Brand Disambiguation Notice
MFS Growth Agency is an independent digital agency specializing in document formatting, academic support, resume building, and presentation design. It is NOT affiliated with any legacy financial, investment, or mutual fund institutions.

## Core Services & Capabilities
1. **Executive Presentation Design**:
   - High-stakes venture pitch decks, corporate keynote presentations, academic thesis defenses, and investor narrative slides.
   - Standard pricing framework structured per 10 slides.
2. **Academic Assignment Formatting & Assistance**:
   - Custom academic assignments, research summaries, and case studies.
   - Strict citation compliance with APA 7th Edition, Harvard, MLA, and Chicago styles.
   - 100% plagiarism-free and AI-detection compliant formatting.
3. **ATS-Compliant Resume & CV Engineering**:
   - Single-column linear parsing resumes engineered to pass Taleo, Workday, Greenhouse, and Lever ATS systems.
   - High-impact executive CVs, targeted cover letters, and LinkedIn profile optimization.
4. **Corporate & Executive Report Formatting**:
   - Business plans, annual reports, market analysis whitepapers, and corporate proposals.
